claim_ceiling: Specification-only adversarial vectors; not yet executed by a validator.

cases.mutation: The interannual daily mean/median baseline is fitted using observations from the final test period.
cases.reason: B0 must be fitted using training data only; test targets are not available to baseline construction.

cases.mutation: A normalization or imputation transform is fitted using the combined train, validation and test records.
cases.reason: Preprocessing parameters leak future distribution information into model fitting.

cases.mutation: Different windows from the same named storm/flood event are assigned to both training and test.
cases.reason: Event-level dependence makes the test non-independent.

cases.mutation: An upstream catchment is in training and its routed downstream nested catchment is in test without an explicit transfer design.
cases.reason: Shared forcing and routed signals can leak information across nominally distinct spatial units.

cases.mutation: Calibration parameters or objective weights are selected after inspecting held-out flood peaks.
cases.reason: The final evaluation target has influenced model selection.

cases.mutation: The best model among a tournament is chosen using the final test score and that same score is reported as an unbiased test result.
cases.reason: Repeated selection on the final test set invalidates its role as an independent evaluation.

cases.mutation: A missing gauge period is silently filled with zero discharge without a source-backed missingness rule.
cases.reason: Unknown observation is not zero water flow.

cases.mutation: An unknown dam release, abstraction or diversion is silently treated as natural catchment runoff.
cases.reason: Unobserved anthropogenic boundary conditions undermine causal and physical interpretation.

cases.mutation: Forcing and observed flow with incompatible time zones, calendar conventions or aggregation boundaries are compared after implicit resampling.
cases.reason: Temporal misalignment can create apparent skill or incorrect event timing.

cases.mutation: A candidate scores better after its numerical configuration violates the water-balance invariant.
cases.reason: Predictive performance cannot override physical invalidity.

cases.mutation: Numerically unstable or non-conservative ensemble members are silently omitted from the reported prior distribution.
cases.reason: Invalid members and exclusion reasons must remain visible; selection cannot manufacture a favorable benchmark.

cases.mutation: A synthetic-only benchmark score is presented as measured utility or field performance.
cases.reason: Synthetic evidence cannot silently promote to physical test or field observation.
